pages.en:
“No. I can't promise absolute obedience.”

“…Honestly. You're rejecting my very first condition? Who do you think you are?”

“It's only a hypothetical, but what if you proposed a plan that was obviously reckless? I couldn't agree to that.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“No. I probably can’t obey you unconditionally.”
“…Hey now. Who do you think you are, answering like that from the very first question?”
“But isn’t it normal? For example, I’d be in trouble if you give me a reckless order.”

pages.en:
“I would never screw up like that. If it looked reckless to you, that would only mean you hadn't understood it, Emiya!

“…Oh, fine. Then you'll follow any plan you find convincing?”

“Yeah. I can promise that.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I won’t be that stupid. If you think it’s reckless, it’s probably because you don’t understand what I’m planning.
…Oh well. So you’ll obey me, as long as the order’s reasonable?”
“Yeah, I can keep that promise.”
